problems.q: What is the hybridization of sulfur in SF6? Sulfur has six single bonds and no lone pairs.
problems.why: Six electron groups need six hybrid orbitals. That set is one s, three p, and two d orbitals: sp3d2. The angles are 90°. OpenStax AF2e §5.3.
hints: Count the groups on sulfur. Six groups are not sp3.

problems.q: What hybridization does each carbon use in C2H4? Each carbon has three groups: two C–H bonds and one C=C bond.
problems.why: A double bond counts as one group. Three groups use sp2 hybrids, and the leftover p orbital makes the pi bond. The bond angles are about 120°. OpenStax AF2e §5.3.
hints: Count groups, not lines. The C=C bond is one group plus a pi bond from an unhybridized p orbital.

problems.q: A pi bond is the side-by-side overlap of two unhybridized p orbitals. Which orbitals overlap that way? Answer p.
problems.why: Sigma bonds form by end-to-end overlap along the line between the nuclei. A pi bond forms when two unhybridized p orbitals overlap above and below that line. OpenStax AF2e §5.2.
hints: The sideways overlap uses the p orbitals that were left out of the hybrid set.

problems.q: What is the bond order of F2 from molecular orbital theory?
problems.why: F2 has 14 valence electrons: 8 in bonding orbitals and 6 in antibonding orbitals. Bond order = (8 − 6) / 2 = 1. OpenStax AF2e §5.4.
hints: Bond order is half the difference between bonding and antibonding electrons. F2 fills the pi-star set more than O2 does.

problems.q: Liquid oxygen is drawn into a magnetic field. Is O2 paramagnetic or diamagnetic?
problems.why: O2 places one electron in each of two pi-star orbitals. Those unpaired electrons make O2 paramagnetic. OpenStax AF2e §5.4.
hints: Look at the pi-star electrons in O2. They do not pair in one orbital.

problems.q: Which sigma molecular orbital is higher in energy, the bonding orbital or the antibonding orbital?
problems.why: A bonding orbital has no node between the nuclei and sits lower in energy. The antibonding orbital has a node between the nuclei and sits higher. OpenStax AF2e §5.4.
hints: The orbital with a node between the nuclei is the higher one.
